title: Logger saw the same craft in the area

tellings.quote: there was a there was a witness logger who had witnessed the this same craft up in that same area that they were logging.

plain: Charlie Foltz, a man who says he saw a strange craft near the Allagash Waterway in Maine in the 1970s, says he was not the only one. According to Foltz, a logger working in that same area also saw the same craft. He tells it as backing from an outside witness for what he and his companions say happened there.
